eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 单二进制

headline.zh:
换模型之前
先看清谁会静默崩掉
headline.en:
Before you switch models
see which one silently breaks

sub.zh: 同一份 prompt + 工具 schema 跑过四个国产模型，立刻报告谁违反了工具调用契约——不需要学习型预言机，你写的不变量就是标准。
sub.en: Run the same prompt + tool schema across four Chinese models and instantly see which one silently violates the tool-call contract — no learned oracle needed, your invariants are the ground truth.

title.zh: 一眼看到哪个模型违约
title.en: See which model breaks at a glance

body.zh: 同一份轨迹 + schema 喂给四个不变量检查器，逐条输出通过/失败和最小证据。不需要跑完全部才知道——哪条挂了、挂在哪个模型上一目了然。
body.en: Feed one trace + schema to four invariant checkers and get per-check pass/fail with minimal evidence. No need to run everything first — which check failed and on which model is visible immediately.

body.zh: 不需要训练预言机或收集标注数据——你写的不变量规则就是 ground truth。简单、确定、可审计。
body.en: No need to train an oracle or collect labeled data — the invariant rules you write ARE the ground truth. Simple, deterministic, auditable.

title.zh: 一条命令，无需 API key

body.zh: m1 只评估保存好的轨迹文件，不需要联网，不需要账号。CI 里也能跑——切了模型就跑一遍，挂了就挡住合并。
body.en: m1 evaluates saved trace files only — no network, no account needed. Runs in CI too: switch a model, run it, and block the merge if it fails.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 把模型替换从盲赌变成可度量的决策
tag.en: MIT open source · Turn model substitution from blind gambling into a measurable decision
